You will use the `Write-PSFMessage logging functions for logging in powershell.
You will use -Level Important for important messages
All logging messages should be written using the `Write-PSFMessage` function. All logging message should include a -Tag parameter with the values '<name of function>, Trace'. additionally, any -Level Error lgging entry should include the additional tag 'Error'
